requires.degrade: Without node, the multi-agent hooks cannot launch, so they do nothing. After node resolves, run `bash <plugin root>/scripts/check-hook-registration.sh`: it reports whether the fetch gate is registered and denies a sample off-host fetch.
Without curl, the drift-audit fetch stage records every page unread, and the checkers read their sources with WebFetch alone.
Without jq, docs-raw.sh stops before reading a page, so the drift-audit checkers read their sources with WebFetch alone.
